source.title: Fermanagh Herald, 6 May 1933, p. 5 ("L.G. elections in Fermanagh: nomination of candidates")
source.publisher: Fermanagh Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Nominated and returned unopposed; the Herald of 6 May 1933 reports contests only in Monea and Enniskillen Urban.

note: Triennial election of Fermanagh County Council, polled Wednesday 31 May 1933 (Fermanagh Herald, 27 May 1933: 'The polling for the election of County and Rural District Councillors will take place in Fermanagh on Wednesday next, 31st May'). Results declared Thursday 1 June. Only Enniskillen Urban and Monea were contested; the remaining eighteen divisions were uncontested and are named in the Herald nominations list of 6 May 1933. There were twenty elected members. Structure and division names for the 1966-67 amalgamation are in notes/fermanagh-fcra-1969.md, from Fermanagh CRA, 'Fermanagh Facts' (1969). That is an advocacy pamphlet: use it for names only, not figures. Its register figures are disputed by Kingsley (2021) on the Omagh Rural District scheme. Read the page image before recording any number from it. Returned unopposed.
